name: Animal and Dairy Science PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $75 first / $25 additional; department pages still show old $100 international. Limited waivers only qualifying-program participants with uploaded evidence; overseas eligibility must be confirmed.

english.note: IELTS every band at least 6. TOEFL new-scale policy applies on/after January 22, 2026; no January 21 rule inferred. Agency reports, MyBest/Home Edition and IELTS Online/One Skill Retake accepted. UGA English Level 6 alternative; DET not accepted. Usually exempt after a degree from an accredited US institution or institution in a primary-English country. At least one current year of US accredited study with strong performance (for example GPA 3.0) may also support waiver. Departments may still require testing; TA English rules are separate.

documents: Official transcripts from all undergraduate/graduate institutions
requirements.note: GPA 3. Faculty must agree to mentor before final acceptance; contact advisers 9–12 months ahead. Statement names adviser contacted and research/career goals. Recommenders usually doctoral-level academics; private-practice veterinarians/employers may be unsuitable. GRE policy not stated.

funding.note: Competitive mentor-awarded RA/TA. Published 2024 PhD 35% appointment: $1,804.85 monthly, tuition waiver for residents/nonresidents; approximately $1,150 semester fees paid by student. Most students assistantships, not a universal guarantee; current rates unconfirmed.
